studio_demo_echo.description:
Echo a message back, optionally upper-cased.

Args:

    shout: When true, the echoed text is upper-cased.

count.description: How many times to repeat the greeting; must be at least 1.

loud.description: When true, the greeting is upper-cased.

studio_demo_form.description:
Build a greeting from a typed set of fields.

The mix of a required string, a bounded integer, an enum, and a boolean is
what the Studio's auto-form renders for a tool that ships no custom panel.

Args:
    name: Who to greet.
    count: How many times to repeat the greeting; must be at least 1.
    mood: Tone of the greeting.
    loud: When true, the greeting is upper-cased.

Returns:
    The rendered greeting and the echoed inputs.

studio_demo_fail.description:
Always raise, so the Studio's error handling can be exercised.

question.description: The question shown to the human.

answer_format.description:
How the answer is collected and typed:
- "text": free-form text, returned as a string.
- "confirm": a yes/no choice, returned as a bool.
- "select": one value from ``options``, the chosen string returned.
- "form": a structured object validated against ``schema``, returned
  as a dict.
- "external": the human acts on an EXTERNAL surface (sign, approve,
  pay) reached through ``link``, and the external system delivers the
  answer through a public callback URL. Returns the callback payload.

schema.description:
A JSON schema describing the answer object; required for "form",
optional for "external" (validates the callback payload).

group_id.description: An optional thread key grouping related questions.

timeout.description:
Seconds to wait before raising; defaults to the configured
interactions timeout.

link.description:
Required for "external", forbidden otherwise. A URL template
containing the literal placeholder ``{callback_url}``, which is
substituted with the public callback URL before the human visits it.

ask_user.description:
Ask a human a question mid-run and block until they answer.

Args:
    question: The question shown to the human.
    answer_format: How the answer is collected and typed:
        - "text": free-form text, returned as a string.
        - "confirm": a yes/no choice, returned as a bool.
        - "select": one value from ``options``, the chosen string returned.
        - "form": a structured object validated against ``schema``, returned
          as a dict.
        - "external": the human acts on an EXTERNAL surface (sign, approve,
          pay) reached through ``link``, and the external system delivers the
          answer through a public callback URL. Returns the callback payload.
    options: The allowed values; required for "select".
    schema: A JSON schema describing the answer object; required for "form",
        optional for "external" (validates the callback payload).
    group_id: An optional thread key grouping related questions.
    timeout: Seconds to wait before raising; defaults to the configured
        interactions timeout.
    link: Required for "external", forbidden otherwise. A URL template
        containing the literal placeholder ``{callback_url}``, which is
        substituted with the public callback URL before the human visits it.

Returns:
    The typed answer (text -> str, confirm -> bool, select -> chosen value,
    form -> validated dict, external -> the callback payload).

Raises:
    InteractionTimeoutError: No answer arrived before the timeout elapsed.
    InteractionLimitError: Too many questions are already open (the
        ``max_concurrent`` guard tripped).
    ValueError: The ``answer_format`` or its argument combination is invalid.
    RuntimeError: An ``external`` question was asked without
        ``INTERACTIONS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL`` configured.

key.description: Unique identifier of the tool to execute.

run_tool.description:
Invoke any registered tool by key with the given arguments.

Args:
    key: Unique identifier of the tool to execute.
    arguments: Parameters matching the tool's signature.

Returns:
    The result returned by the executed tool.

reload_tool.description:
Re-register one app tool (e.g. kind "flow") from its current stored definition.

Applied on this worker and broadcast to the fleet (all workers, or only
``targets``); each worker re-reads the definition itself, so the op carries only
the kind and name. The response embeds the per-origin fleet report.

remove_tool.description:
Remove one app tool (e.g. kind "flow") from the live registry.

Applied on this worker and broadcast to the fleet (all workers, or only
``targets``); the response embeds the per-origin fleet report.

reload_config.description:
Soft-restart: refresh env from the config manager, reset every settings cache,
and re-initialize from the manifest — in-process, no pod restart. Applied on this
worker (when it is a target) and broadcast to the fleet (all workers, or only
``targets``); the response embeds the per-origin fleet report.

Heavy (a full re-init); meant for env/config saves, not tool edits. A convergence
op: its whole purpose is aligning siblings to persisted state, so a failed local
reload still broadcasts and then re-raises with the fleet report attached.
